opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, resident in the UK, with a demonstrable interest in the relevant industry (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture, pig).
opportunities.summary: A 30-day fully funded study tour programme for young people aged 18-24, aimed at developing young talent in the farming industry. It links successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network, includes all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. For 2027, three dairy and three pig scholarships are planned.
